title: Maisema ja kulttuuriperintö – Landskap och kulturarv
bookshelves: Category: Reference, Information and Interdisciplinary subjects
Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: What does the landscape look like when someone else looks at it? Who gets to define and name the landscape? Can a cultural landscape be transferred to another environment? A landscape is a cultural performance, a stage for action and a field of political meanings. The articles in the book Maisema ja kulttuuriperintö – Landskap och kulturarv (Landscape and Cultural Heritage) explore national landscapes, forests and waterways, but also the politics of place names and digital cottage shores. Some of the landscapes studied are imagined, some can be experienced with all the senses, and the very existence of others is a matter of contention. Landscapes are formed of cultural memory, contemporary understanding, and visions for the future.
